青川按 `invoice_no` 去重：先规范化（去空格、统一大小写/全半角），再分组保留一条，优先保留更新时间最新或状态最完整记录；导出加 `invoice_no` 非空与唯一校验。若一发票多明细，则用 `(invoice_no, line_no)` 去重，不能只靠 `invoice_no`。

Give corresponding dedup suggestion: dedup by invoice_no, retain latest/business priority, handle null/multi-line? Need not overdo. Maybe normalize invoice_no (trim, case, full-width?) and uniqueness index. If invoice_no non-unique across invoice lines, use invoice_no + line_no; but they asked corresponding. Should not conflate with Qinglan. Answer directly. Add <|task:3|>. Ensure no extra after marker except whitespace. Normal answer.
